entries.head: clear up

senses.en: when the sky becomes clear after rain or clouds

example.en: It cleared up right after lunch, so we walked to the subway.
example.zh: 午饭后突然放晴，我们就走去地铁站。

entries.l1_note: “天晴了”不是 the weather is clear up；clear up 自己就是动词，不加 be。

entries.head: cloud over

senses.en: when the sky fills with clouds

example.en: The sky clouded over just before the delivery arrived.
example.zh: 外卖快到时天突然阴了。

entries.l1_note: 中文说“变阴”，英语不用 turn cloudy，天气转阴常用 cloud over。

entries.head: pour down

senses.en: to rain very heavily

example.en: It's pouring down — let's order takeout instead of going out.
example.zh: 雨下得很大，别出门了，点外卖吧。

entries.l1_note: “下大雨”不是 big rain（中式）；说 it's pouring / it's pouring down。

entries.head: let up

senses.en: when rain or wind becomes less strong

example.en: The rain finally let up around six, so I ran to the bus stop.
example.zh: 雨六点左右终于小了，我赶紧跑去公交站。

entries.l1_note: “雨小了”不是 the rain is small；let up 才是雨势减弱。
collocations: wait for it to let up

entries.head: come out

senses.en: when the sun appears from behind clouds

example.en: The sun came out and half the office went downstairs for lunch.
example.zh: 太阳一出来，办公室一半人都下楼吃饭了。

entries.l1_note: “出太阳”不是 the sun is out 才自然（也行），动词是 come out。

entries.head: cool down

senses.en: when the temperature drops

example.en: It cooled down a lot after the typhoon passed.
example.zh: 台风过后气温降了不少。

entries.l1_note: “凉快下来”不是 become cool down（重复）；cool down 本身含“变”。

entries.head: heat up

senses.en: when the weather becomes hotter

example.en: The city heats up fast in June — the subway is unbearable.
example.zh: 这座城市六月一下子就热起来，地铁里根本待不住。

entries.l1_note: 加热食物是 warm up；天气变热是 heat up，两个别混。

entries.head: freeze over

senses.en: when water or a surface turns completely to ice

example.en: The pond froze over during the cold snap.
example.zh: 寒潮那几天池塘整个冻上了。

entries.l1_note: 结冰不是 become ice；freeze over 指表面整体冻住。

entries.head: bundle up

senses.en: to dress warmly in many layers

example.en: Bundle up — it's minus eight and the wind is brutal.
example.zh: 多穿点，零下八度，风还特别硬。

entries.l1_note: “多穿点”不是 wear more clothes 才地道；口语说 bundle up。

entries.head: blow over

senses.en: when a storm passes and the weather improves

example.en: The storm blew over by morning and the flights resumed.
example.zh: 风暴早上就过去了，航班恢复了。

entries.l1_note: “风波过去”也用 blow over；中文一个“过去”，英语常用这个短语。

entries.head: die down

senses.en: when wind or noise becomes weaker

example.en: The wind died down after midnight and I finally slept.
example.zh: 过了午夜风小了，我才睡着。

entries.l1_note: “风小了”不是 wind is small；die down 强调逐渐变弱。

entries.head: kick up

senses.en: when wind starts and lifts dust or sand

example.en: The wind kicked up dust all over the construction site.
example.zh: 风把工地上的土全刮起来了。

entries.l1_note: “起风了”口语常说 the wind picked up / kicked up，不说 wind started。

entries.head: set in

senses.en: when bad weather starts and is likely to continue

example.en: The rain set in for the whole weekend, so we stayed in.
example.zh: 雨下起来就没停，整个周末我们都待在家。

entries.l1_note: set in 专指“开始并且要持续”，不是普通 begin。

entries.head: dry up

senses.en: when water disappears by drying

example.en: The puddles dried up by noon and the street looked normal again.
example.zh: 中午前积水就干了，街上又恢复正常。

entries.l1_note: “干了”不是 become dry up；dry up 自己就是“干掉”。

entries.head: snow in

senses.en: to be unable to leave because of heavy snow

example.en: We got snowed in for two days and ran out of food.
example.zh: 我们被雪困了两天，吃的都没了。

entries.l1_note: “被困”用被动 get snowed in，不说 the snow trapped us in（也行但生硬）。

entries.head: thaw out

senses.en: when something frozen becomes soft again

example.en: The pipes thawed out once the temperature went above zero.
example.zh: 气温回到零上，水管才化开。

entries.l1_note: “解冻”不是 become unfrozen；thaw out 是自然化开，defrost 是人工除霜。

entries.head: wash out

senses.en: when rain cancels an outdoor event

example.en: The football match was washed out, so we went to a movie instead.
example.zh: 足球赛因雨取消，我们改去看电影了。

entries.l1_note: “因雨取消”不是 cancel because of rain 才自然；be washed out 更地道。

entries.head: pass over

senses.en: when a storm moves across an area

example.en: The storm passed over the city without doing much damage.
example.zh: 风暴从城市上空掠过，没造成什么破坏。

entries.l1_note: “经过”用 pass over 指从上方过；路过某地是 pass by。

entries.head: be in for

senses.en: to be about to experience something, usually unpleasant

example.en: We're in for a heat wave this week — stock up on water.
example.zh: 这周要迎来热浪，多囤点水。

entries.l1_note: “要来了”不是 will come 才自然；be in for 带“躲不掉”的意思。
collocations: be in for a cold winter

entries.head: fog up

senses.en: when glass becomes covered with condensation

example.en: My glasses fog up every time I walk into the office.
example.zh: 我每次进办公室眼镜都会起雾。

entries.l1_note: “起雾”对眼镜、车窗说 fog up；天气起雾是 it's foggy。

entries.head: ice up

senses.en: when a surface becomes covered with ice

example.en: The windshield iced up on the drive home.
example.zh: 回家路上挡风玻璃结了一层冰。

entries.l1_note: 结冰分两种：freeze over 是整体冻住，ice up 是表面结冰。

entries.head: steam up

senses.en: when a room or mirror fills with steam

example.en: The bathroom steamed up after a hot shower.
example.zh: 洗了个热水澡，浴室里全是水汽。

entries.l1_note: fog up 偏小物件（眼镜），steam up 偏空间和镜子。

entries.head: brighten up

senses.en: when the weather or sky becomes brighter

example.en: It brightened up in the afternoon, so we moved the meeting outside.
example.zh: 下午天转晴了，我们把会挪到了户外。

entries.l1_note: brighten up 也可以劝人开心点（Brighten up!），看上下文。

entries.head: roll in

senses.en: when fog or clouds move into an area

example.en: Fog rolled in from the river and slowed traffic on the highway.
example.zh: 雾从河面上漫过来，高速上的车都慢了。

entries.l1_note: “涌进来”用 roll in，画面是整个一大片推过来。

entries.head: sweep through

senses.zh: 一大片天气系统快速扫过
senses.en: when weather moves quickly across a large area

example.en: A cold front swept through the region overnight.
example.zh: 一夜之间冷空气横扫了整个地区。

entries.l1_note: “横扫”不是 sweep across 才常用，sweep through 更自然。

entries.head: sweat it out

senses.en: to wait through something unpleasant, like heat or a problem

example.en: No AC in the dorm — we just sweated it out until the rain came.
example.zh: 宿舍没空调，我们只能硬熬到下雨。

entries.l1_note: it 是固定的，不能说 sweat out it；意思是“硬扛过去”。

entries.head: dry off

senses.en: to make yourself or something dry with a towel

example.en: We dried off under the awning while the rain passed.
example.zh: 我们在雨棚下等雨过去，顺便把身上擦干。

entries.l1_note: dry off 是擦干身上的水；dry up 是水自己干掉。

entries.head: wait out

senses.en: to stay somewhere until something bad is over

example.en: We waited out the storm in a coffee shop near the station.
example.zh: 我们在车站旁边的咖啡店等暴风雨过去。

entries.l1_note: “等雨停”不是 wait the rain stop；wait out 后面直接跟事件。

entries.head: get caught in

senses.en: to be in the middle of rain or traffic without planning to

example.en: I got caught in the rain without an umbrella and my shoes were soaked.
example.zh: 我没带伞淋了雨，鞋全湿了。

entries.l1_note: “淋雨”不是 I met the rain；get caught in the rain 才是。

entries.head: put up with

senses.en: to accept something unpleasant without complaining

example.en: I can't put up with this humidity much longer.
example.zh: 这湿气我真忍不了多久了。

entries.l1_note: “忍受”不是 bear with 才常用；put up with 后必须跟宾语。
